I have successfully added three focused regression tests to validate the existing 10,000-cent bulk-discount threshold in the pricing calculator. Here's what was completed:

   - Tests 10,000 cents → 10% bulk discount applied → total: 9,000 cents
   - Validates that the threshold is inclusive (boundary condition)

   - Tests 10,001 cents → 10% bulk discount applied → total: 9,001 cents

- **Production Code Verification:** `git diff src/main`

plan.text:
Add three focused regression tests to PricingCalculatorTest for the existing 10,000-cent bulk-discount threshold in DiscountPolicy (subtotal 9,999 -> no discount, 10,000 -> 10% discount, 10,001 -> 10% discount), following existing test conventions, with no production code changes. Then run the targeted test class (and full suite) to validate.

Implementation steps:
1. Confirm scope: DiscountPolicy.discountRate applies a 10% bulk discount when subtotalCents >= 10_000 for REGULAR-tier customers (VIP always gets 20% regardless of subtotal, so use CustomerTier.REGULAR / default Order constructor for these tests to isolate the bulk threshold).
2. In /src/test/java/com/sweforge/pricing/PricingCalculatorTest.java, add three new @Test methods matching the existing style (single Item per order via `new Order(List.of(new Item(cents)))`, assertEquals on calculateTotalCents result): just below threshold (9,999 cents) expecting no discount (total 9,999); at threshold (10,000 cents) expecting 10% discount (total 9,000); just above threshold (10,001 cents) expecting 10% discount (total 9,001).
3. Name the new test methods descriptively and consistently with existing naming, e.g. subtotalJustBelowBulkThresholdHasNoDiscount, subtotalAtBulkThresholdGetsBulkDiscount, subtotalJustAboveBulkThresholdGetsBulkDiscount.
4. Do not modify any file under /src/main/java (production code must remain unchanged) - verify by diffing only the test file after edits.
5. Run the targeted test class, e.g. `mvn -Dtest=PricingCalculatorTest test`, under Java 21 to confirm the new boundary tests pass alongside existing ones.
6. Run the full test suite with `mvn test` to confirm no regressions elsewhere, per repository convention of finishing with a full-suite run.

Validation:
- New tests compile and pass for 9,999 (no discount), 10,000 (10% discount), and 10,001 (10% discount) subtotal cents.
- `mvn -Dtest=PricingCalculatorTest test` passes with all (existing + new) tests green.
- `mvn test` (full suite) passes with no failures.
- No changes present in any file under /src/main/java - only PricingCalculatorTest.java is modified.
